MOD = 998244353
G = 3

def fast_power(base, exp):
    result = 1
    base %= MOD
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def bit_swap(array, length):
    j = 0
    for i in range(1, length):
        bit = length >> 1
        while j >= bit:
            j -= bit
            bit >>= 1
        j += bit
        if i < j:
            array[i], array[j] = array[j], array[i]

def fft_transform(array, length, direction):
    bit_swap(array, length)
    size = 2
    while size <= length:
        wlen = fast_power(G, (MOD - 1) // size)
        if direction == -1:
            wlen = fast_power(wlen, MOD - 2)
        for start in range(0, length, size):
            w = 1
            half = size // 2
            for k in range(start, start + half):
                u = array[k]
                v = array[k + half] * w % MOD
                array[k] = (u + v) % MOD
                array[k + half] = (u - v + MOD) % MOD
                w = w * wlen % MOD
        size <<= 1
    if direction == -1:
        inv_len = fast_power(length, MOD - 2)
        for i in range(length):
            array[i] = array[i] * inv_len % MOD

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))
    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    halfN = n // 2
    len_pow = 1
    while len_pow < (9 * halfN + 1):
        len_pow <<= 1
    arr = [0] * len_pow
    for x in data[2:2 + m]:
        arr[x] = 1
    fft_transform(arr, len_pow, 1)
    for i in range(len_pow):
        if arr[i] != 0:
            arr[i] = fast_power(arr[i], halfN) % MOD
    fft_transform(arr, len_pow, -1)
    total = 0
    for i in range(len_pow):
        total = (total + arr[i] * arr[i]) % MOD
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
